core_obligations: Assume g o f finite (resp. integral) and g separated and record the base change X x_Z Y -> Y (proof lines 9537-9540).
Show that the graph X -> X x_Z Y is a closed immersion and hence finite (resp. integral) (proof lines 9541-9545).
Conclude that f is finite (resp. integral) as a composite of two such morphisms (proof lines 9546-9548).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with two assertions: if g o f is finite and g is separated then f is finite, and the same with integral in place of finite (source lines 9527-9535). The proof factors f through the fibre product: X x_Z Y -> Y is finite (resp. integral) by base change of g o f, the graph X -> X x_Z Y is a closed immersion because Y -> Z is separated, a closed immersion is finite (resp. integral), and a composite of finite (resp. integral) morphisms is finite (resp. integral).
